convergence.description: Gate config-done on the MPLS L3VPN converging end to end: OSPF area-0 core up, LDP transport operational, VPNv4 customer routes imported on every PE, and customer sites reachable across the VPN. A config-time suite, so a failed gate leaves the lab deployed but marks it validation_failed. Companion to examples/mpls-l3vpn.yml; seed it via the deploy request's test_suites, or PUT it to an existing lab.

ospf_full.description: Every node has formed a Full OSPF adjacency (the area-0 core is up).

ldp_operational.description: Every node has an OPERATIONAL LDP session (MPLS transport LSPs established).

vpnv4_routes_imported.description: Each PE has installed BGP-learned (MP-BGP VPNv4) customer routes in the vpn_a VRF.

vpn_reach_pe1_to_pe2.description: pe1 reaches pe2's customer site across the L3VPN (data plane over the label-switched core).

vpn_reach_pe1_to_pe3.description: pe1 reaches pe3's customer site across the L3VPN.

vpn_reach_pe1_to_pe4.description: pe1 reaches pe4's customer site across the L3VPN.

vpn_reach_pe4_to_pe1.description: pe4 reaches pe1's customer site (reverse path) across the L3VPN.
